title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Customer Success Manager Enterprise Accounts Company: Flick Network
 Location: Remote (India)
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Experience: 4–7 Years
 Working Hours: UAE Business Hours (Monday–Friday)
 Department: Customer Success / Account Management
 Reports To: Founder
 Travel: Occasional travel to UAE, Oman and Saudi Arabia for client meetings. About Flick Network Flick Network is an e-invoicing and compliance technology company helping businesses navigate government-mandated e-invoicing requirements across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Malaysia, Nigeria, the Philippines, Jordan and other markets. We are an accredited Peppol Access Point, connecting enterprise ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite and Zoho with tax authority platforms. Our clients include leading organisations across energy, telecommunications, transportation, retail and other industries. Job Summary We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Customer Success Manager – Enterprise Accounts to manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market customers. The ideal candidate will take ownership of the complete customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to go-live, relationship management, renewals and account expansion. This is a client-facing, ownership-driven role that requires excellent communication, strong follow-up skills, commercial awareness and the ability to coordinate multiple internal teams. You will act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring timely responses, successful project delivery, customer satisfaction and long-term business growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise Client Relationship Management Own and manage a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts. Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, including CFOs, Finance Controllers, IT Heads and Procurement Teams. Conduct client kick-off meetings, weekly status calls and periodic business reviews. Ensure all client queries and communications receive timely responses, preferably within one business hour. Maintain regular communication and proactively identify customer concerns. 2. Customer Onboarding & Project Delivery Drive customer onboarding and implementation activities through to successful go-live. Coordinate Peppol, FTA and other regulatory registrations. Follow up on ERP integration, master data readiness, UAT and client approvals. Coordinate with Integration, Technical, Support and Project Delivery teams. Monitor project timelines, identify delays and escalate blockers proactively. Ensure projects are delivered within committed timelines. 3. Account Growth & Revenue Expansion Identify opportunities for account expansion, including additional entities, countries, ERP integrations and product modules. Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts. Coordinate with the Sales team to convert qualified expansion opportunities. Drive subscription renewals and ensure timely renewal planning. Build long-term relationships that generate repeat business and customer referrals. 4. Customer Retention & Satisfaction Monitor account health and proactively identify potential customer churn. Develop and execute customer recovery plans wherever required. Collect customer feedback, testimonials and case studies. Work with Product and Engineering teams to address recurring customer challenges. Maintain accurate CRM records, account updates and communication history. Required Qualifications & Experience 4–7 years of experience in Customer Success, Key Account Management, Enterprise Account Management or B2B SaaS Sales. Proven experience managing enterprise clients and multiple stakeholders. Experience in account growth, upselling, cross-selling and subscription renewals. Strong communication and client relationship management skills. Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and implementation projects simultaneously. Strong follow-up, negotiation and problem-solving abilities. Good understanding of ERP integrations, APIs, data mapping and UAT processes. Excellent verbal and written English communication. Comfortable working with international clients and UAE business hours. Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Zoho CRM or Salesforce. Preferred Qualifications Experience in e-invoicing, fintech, ERP, SaaS or tax compliance solutions. Knowledge of UAE FTA, Saudi ZATCA, Oman Fawtara and Peppol regulations. Experience working with clients in the GCC region. Familiarity with Jira and project management tools. Arabic language skills will be an added advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Client response time: Within 1 business hour. Client meeting follow-ups: Same business day. Project go-live achievement: 90% or above. Gross Revenue Retention: 95% or above. Customer satisfaction: Average 9/10. Proactive identification of account expansion opportunities. Timely renewals and customer retention. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who: Takes complete ownership of customer relationships. Is proactive and follows up without waiting for reminders. Can confidently communicate with senior management and enterprise stakeholders. Has a commercial mindset and understands revenue growth. Can manage challenging client situations with professionalism. Is highly organised and capable of managing multiple priorities. Focuses on customer retention, satisfaction and long-term business relationships. If you are passionate about customer success, enterprise relationship management and driving business growth, we would love to hear from you! Job Location: Remote – India
 Company: Flick Network
 Employment Type: Full-time

title: Support Operations Lead
description:
Support Operations Lead Job Description
 
 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with
 our Support Product Manager, and the two of you will own Support as a function together: you own how
 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.
 Your goal is simple to state and hard to do: learners get fast, correct, friendly help, and the support team
 runs on clear processes and the right metrics.
 
 Position Details
 Employment Type Full Time
 Experience 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, at manager level or
 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company
 Location Remote, Kolkata (preferred)
 Work Days 5 Days (official). Weekend work may be required depending on business
 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do
 • Own support operations end to end: queues, routing, SLAs, escalations, staffing and shift planning.
 • Pick the metrics that matter (first response time, resolution time, first contact resolution, CSAT, ticket
 volume per learner, backlog) and review them every week.
 • Design and document support processes, macros and escalation paths, and keep them current as the
 product changes.
 • Find the top reasons learners contact us, and work with the Support PM and other product teams to
 remove them at the source.
 • Work with the Support PM on bots, self-serve help and tooling. Bring the ground truth from the floor
 into what gets built.
 • Run quality: ticket audits, feedback loops and training for agents, including training on new product
 changes.
 • Lead and grow the support team leads, and build a culture of ownership and care for the learner. 
 What you bring
 • 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, with at least part of that as a manager or above, in
 a consumer (B2C) product company.
 • You have owned support metrics and can show a time you improved them, with the before and after
 numbers.
 • You have designed support processes from scratch or fixed broken ones: routing, SLAs, escalation,
 QA.
 • Hands-on with helpdesk and support tools (for example Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar) and
 with spreadsheets for analysis.
 • Comfortable working with product and tech teams, and able to turn a support problem into a clear ask.
 • Calm under pressure, with high volumes and a large, varied learner base.
 Nice to have
 • Edtech, subscriptions or other high-volume consumer services.
 • Experience rolling out chatbots, AI agents or self-serve help centres.
 • Support in multiple Indian languages.
 
 About be10X
 At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI
 upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes,
 sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet.
 Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career
 trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product,
 and Business.
 And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR
 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru &
 Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.   
 The Be10x Effect
 • Google's Official Stamp of Approval – Be10x is a certified Google partner, putting us in a league
 most training platforms only dream of reaching.
 • From Classrooms to Warships – We delivered classified-ready AI training for the Indian Navy: a
 2-day program covering Excel + AI and Power BI dashboards with AI-powered decision briefs, built
 around a strict "data never leaves the laptop" security framework.
 • Now Streaming: Our Own Success Story – Be10x's journey is featured on JioHotstar's "Bharat of
 My Dreams" (2026) – proof that we're not just building careers, we're telling their stories.
 • Star-Studded Sessions – Our stages have hosted names like Boman Irani, Ashneer Grover, and
 Imtiaz Ali, because we believe AI education deserves the same spotlight as prime-time TV.
 • Community First – Proud partners and contributors of the Ahmedabad Rotary Association, Assam
 Chief Minister Office (CMO) contributing to initiatives that create meaningful social and professional
 impact.
 • AI Masterclass with Rotary Ahmedabad – Be10x led the “Orenda Skyline AI Masterclass” at Pandit
 Deendayal Auditorium, Ahmedabad, with 500+ industrialists, professionals, Rotarians and students.
 • Assam Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Assam floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Bihar Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Bihar floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Official AI Partner – Afghanistan Cricket Board – Be10x is now the Official AI Partner of the
 Afghanistan Cricket Board, applying practical AI tools and workflows to support the board’s teams and
 operations.
 Part of House of EdTech
 be10X is part of House of EdTech, a multi-entity upskilling group whose brands include Office Master, AI for
 Techies, Dr. Finance, Profit Uni, and SpringPad.
